svg.aria-label: Mastery Map: who is weak at what. Animation: a fictional Grade 11 maths class on a map of 23 skills in four topics, coloured week by week by the class average chance of answering a typical question right, as the topics are taught.
svg.title: Mastery Map
svg.text: Who is weak at what, and why.
From quiz and homework answers: each student's
chance on every skill, the weak spots and the
weak prerequisites behind them, and a personal
practice set for everyone, ready to print.
A fictional Grade 11 class on the skill map, week by week
Grey: not taught yet · red flowing: a weak prerequisite holding a skill back
